plan.goal: Determine the number of biological replicates per group needed to detect a small 0.2-sigma difference between two groups with 80% power at alpha 0.05.
plan.rationale: Two-sample two-sided t-test power calculation. Effect size expressed in sigma units (0.2σ = Cohen's d of 0.2), so effect_size=0.2 with std_dev=1.0. Target power 0.8, alpha 0.05.
caveats: Effect size is expressed in sigma units (0.2σ); if the raw measurement SD differs, convert the effect to the same units before using.
This is a two-sided test; a one-sided hypothesis would require slightly fewer replicates.
393 per group assumes a two-sample t-test; paired or repeated-measures designs can reduce the required N.

provenance.formula: n from two-sample t-test power equation
